DisableAdBlock.title: Disable AdBlock
DisableAdBlock.description: Force-disables ad blocking across corporate managed endpoints.

DisableRecording.title: Disable Recording
DisableRecording.description: Disables screen and video recording for Data Loss Prevention (DLP) compliance.

DisableThirdPartyAPIs.title: Disable Third-Party Telemetry & APIs
DisableThirdPartyAPIs.description: Blocks external network calls to third-party endpoints (Dislikes API and Annotation Archive).

ForceDefaultQuality.title: Force Default Video Quality
ForceDefaultQuality.description: Enforces a default video playback quality (e.g., hd720 or hd1080) to conserve corporate network bandwidth.
